transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I've just been feeling really depressed and sad, almost like I'm completely empty inside. This constant low mood has been going on for about two years and two months now, and it just never seems to lift.
During those two years, have there been any periods lasting two months or more when you felt mostly back to normal, or has the low mood been there nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This low mood and sadness have been there nearly every single day for the entire two years and two months. I can't remember a time during this whole period where I felt back to normal for even a few weeks.

During this time, have there been periods of at least two weeks when your depression got noticeably worse and you also had several other symptoms like loss of interest, sleep or appetite changes, low energy, guilt, poor concentration, or thoughts of death?

No, I haven't really had any sudden, severe dips like that or those specific changes with my sleep, appetite, or thoughts of death. My low mood, fatigue, and feelings of worthlessness have just been a constant, steady baseline for the past two years.

Along with the low mood, have you also had poor appetite or overeating, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, low energy, low self-esteem, poor concentration or difficulty making decisions, or feelings of hopelessness?

I haven't really had issues with my sleep or appetite, but I definitely struggle with constantly low energy and feeling exhausted. I also have very low self-esteem, constantly blaming myself, and I feel completely hopeless about the future ever getting better.
How much has this ongoing depression affected your daily life, like your work, relationships, or ability to take care of things?

It has had a massive impact, as my constant physical and mental fatigue makes even basic chores and work feel incredibly heavy and exhausting. I've completely lost confidence in my ability to handle tasks properly, and it's just draining since this has been dragging on for over two years now.
